weekly_theme.summary: 太陽剛進入天秤座不久，生活重心可能悄悄轉往天秤座相關的主題與氣氛。

aries.horoscope: 白羊座，在你的社區舉行親密聚會可能會吸引一些有趣的人。然而，你可能會覺得有點不舒服，並想留在家裡。偶爾精力下降是正常的，特別是在忙碌之後。如果你能激發動力，參加可能會有幫助。最終，選擇權在您，但無論您如何決定，請務必品嚐當晚的美食。
aries.horoscope_en: An intimate get-together in your community might draw some intriguing individuals, Aries. However, you might be feeling a bit off and tempted to stay in. It's normal for your energy to dip occasionally, especially after a hectic period. If you can muster the motivation, it could be beneficial to attend. Ultimately, the choice is yours, but whatever you decide, make sure to savor the evening.

taurus.horoscope: Taurus ，看一眼你的銀行帳戶，可能會發現餘額與預期不符。雖然你可能不會感到驚慌，但可能會產生一種失望的感覺。請記住，收入總是可以補充的，而不是沉溺於此。深呼吸，致力於更節儉一點，優先考慮您的基本支出，並堅持堅實的財務策略。不久之後，你會感謝你所採取的積極措施。
taurus.horoscope_en: Taurus, a glance at your bank account may show a balance that's not quite what you anticipated. While you might not feel alarmed, a sense of disappointment could creep in. Instead of dwelling on it, remember that income can always be replenished. Take a deep breath, commit to being a bit more frugal, prioritize your essential expenses, and adhere to a solid financial strategy. Before long, you'll appreciate the proactive steps you've taken.

gemini.horoscope: 雙子座，在燃燒午夜油嗎？真的有什麼關鍵的東西會讓你分散對家人或伴侶的注意力嗎？可能不會！花點時間評估你認為今晚需要注意的事項。您可能會發現，無需處理每一項任務，您的工作場所就可以生存。盡你所能，然後回到最重要的人身邊。他們也值得你花時間！
gemini.horoscope_en: Burning the midnight oil, Gemini? Is there really anything so crucial that it distracts you from your family or partner? Likely not! Take a moment to assess what you believe needs your attention tonight. You might discover that your workplace can survive without you tackling every single task. Accomplish what you can, then head home to those who matter most. They deserve your time, too!

cancer.horoscope: 巨蟹座，今晚你可能會發現自己參加了線上祈禱或冥想聚會，在那裡練習的靈性方面可能會與你產生深刻的共鳴。您會在這羣成員中感受到一種輕鬆的感覺，感謝他們提供的友情和鼓勵。今晚擁抱這種令人振奮的能量，並努力盡可能長時間保持它，因為它可以在充滿挑戰的時刻成為力量的源泉。
cancer.horoscope_en: This evening, Cancer, you might find yourself participating in an online prayer or meditation gathering, where the spiritual aspects of the practice could deeply resonate with you. You'll feel a sense of ease among the members of this group, appreciating the camaraderie and encouragement they offer. Embrace this uplifting energy tonight and strive to hold onto it as long as possible, as it can serve as a source of strength during challenging moments.

leo.horoscope: Leo ，最近你的愛情生活一直在蓬勃發展，但今天你可能會發現自己有點孤立，無法與現在或潛在的伴侶聯繫。這可能會激起一些意想不到的悲傷感覺，直到現在你還能避免。與其沉浸在這些情緒中，不如將精力轉向一些令人愉快的事情。保持忙碌，直到你的朋友可以來參觀，你可以一起分享一些樂趣。
leo.horoscope_en: Recently, Leo, your love life has been thriving, but today you might find yourself feeling a bit isolated, unable to connect with a current or potential partner. This could stir up some unexpected feelings of sadness that you've managed to avoid until now. Instead of dwelling on these emotions, redirect your energy towards something enjoyable. Keep yourself occupied until your friend can drop by for a visit, and you can share some fun together.

virgo.horoscope: 今天查看財務狀況時，你可能會發現餘額低於預期。雖然這不是一個重大問題，但仍可能令人失望。更光明的是，一份有希望的合同即將完成，可以幫助您彌補任何損失。與此同時，請考慮收緊預算，以確保在新協議達成之前，您的財務穩定性保持不變。
virgo.horoscope_en: As you review your finances today, you might discover that your balance is lower than expected. While this isn't a major issue, it may still come as a letdown. On a brighter note, a promising contract is nearing completion that could help you recover any losses. In the meantime, consider tightening your budget to ensure your financial stability remains intact until the new deal comes through.

libra.horoscope: 對周遭的壓力感到不知所措？不要失去希望。花點時間思考發生的一切。找出您希望看到一些轉變的領域。作出選擇後，請立即採取行動。這種方法比等待一次重大機會立即改變一切要容易得多，而這種機會可能永遠不會到來。採用循序漸進的策略可以實現成果。
libra.horoscope_en: Feeling overwhelmed by the pressures surrounding you? Don't lose hope. Take a moment to contemplate everything that's been happening. Identify the areas where you'd like to see some transformation. Once you've made your choice, take action without delay. This method is far more manageable than holding out for a single grand opportunity to change everything at once, which may never arrive. Embracing a gradual, step-by-step strategy can lead to fulfilling outcomes.

scorpio.horoscope: 天蠍座，如果你處於一段關係中，你可能會目睹伴侶的能量出人意料地轉變，從完全的冷漠轉變為強烈的激情。這種突然的變化可能會讓你措手不及，讓你不確定該如何回應。對於單身人士，請留意吸引人的新聯繫；只要記下他們的聯繫方式，因為你可能會忘記這一刻！ 隨身攜帶紙筆，確保不會錯過任何機會！
scorpio.horoscope_en: Scorpio, if you're in a relationship, you might witness a surprising shift in your partner's energy, transforming from complete indifference to intense passion. This sudden change could catch you off guard, leaving you unsure of how to respond. For those of you who are single, be on the lookout for a captivating new connection; just make sure to jot down their contact details, as you might forget in the moment! Keep a pen and paper close by to ensure you don't let any opportunities slip away!

sagittarius.horoscope: 射手座，如果你期待浪漫的旅人入住你的旅居，請深呼吸，不要擔心讓一切變得完美。由於不可預見的情況，您的好友可能無法按時完成行程。不要讓你的思緒徘徊在最壞的情況下，而是放鬆並享受預期。他們會抵達，雖然比預期晚一點。擁抱這一刻，享受美好時光！
sagittarius.horoscope_en: Sagittarius, if you're expecting a romantic guest at your place, take a breath and don't stress about getting everything perfect just yet. It seems your friend may be running behind schedule due to unforeseen circumstances. Instead of letting your mind wander to worst-case scenarios, relax and enjoy the anticipation. They will arrive, albeit a bit later than expected. Embrace the moment and have a great time!

capricorn.horoscope: 摩羯座，今天有朋友可能會和你分享一些有趣的消息。有可能有人正在結婚！雖然你通常不太重視謠言，但你朋友的熱情可能會影響你相信每一個字。請保持謹慎！您收到的資訊可能並不完全是錯誤的，但它可能會被修飾。在您有機會看到相關人員之前，請不要將其視為事實。
capricorn.horoscope_en: A friend might share some intriguing news with you today, Capricorn. There’s a chance that someone is tying the knot! While you typically don’t place much importance on rumors, your friend’s enthusiasm could sway you into believing every word. Stay cautious! The information you receive might not be entirely false, but it could be embellished. Hold off on accepting it as fact until you have a chance to see the individuals involved.

aquarius.horoscope: 今天，水瓶座，你可能會發現，你一直渴望為親人購買的最後一刻禮物從你的手中滑落。當您造訪各家商店時，可能會發現該商品已售罄。雖然這可能會讓人感到沮喪，但沒有必要失去希望。不妨考慮探索線上選項或選擇其他禮物，為未來的生日慶祝活動儲存所需的物品。深呼吸，享受購物體驗！
aquarius.horoscope_en: Today, Aquarius, you might find that a last-minute present you've been eager to purchase for a loved one slips through your fingers. As you visit various shops, you may discover that the item is out of stock. While this may feel disheartening, there's no need to lose hope. Consider exploring online options or selecting an alternative gift, saving the desired item for a future birthday celebration. Take a deep breath and enjoy your shopping experience!

pisces.horoscope: 雙魚座，今天你可能會發現似乎沒有什麼是完全正確的。您的周圍環境可能會感到不舒服，家具可能需要重新布置，您可能會對自己的外觀感到不滿意。這可能會觸發你內心的完美主義者，促使你採取行動，嘗試修復一切。但是，最好退後一步。您可能無法採取任何措施來改善目前的情況。喘口氣；明天將帶來全新的視角。
pisces.horoscope_en: Today, Pisces, you might find that nothing seems quite right. Your surroundings may feel off, the furniture might need rearranging, and you could be feeling less than satisfied with your appearance. This could trigger your inner perfectionist, pushing you to take action in an attempt to fix everything. However, it might be best to take a step back. There's likely little you can do to improve the situation today. Take a breather; tomorrow will bring a fresh perspective.
